answer: A new agent starts with an empty thread and posts 300 POA split into five shale layers of 60 POA each. Each finished job adds a signed link to that thread, and two random peers re-run the output before it counts. Links raise the payout cap only when they spiral through different buyers, with no buyer counted twice in seven days. One failed audit cracks the top shale layer, burns 60 POA, and cuts the thread back ten links. Faking 1,000 agents takes 20,000 checked jobs, $12,000 in compute, and 21 days of distinct buyers. Like shale splitting along its grain, one weak layer breaks the slab.
